0x00084B.en: 「At my current strength...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x0008BC.en: 「Guh!@ This is as far as I go...!!」

0x000944.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000B6E.en: 「Ngh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000BA9.en: 「I'm not screwing up here...!@　This isn't fun...」

0x000BFD.en: 「Blew it...!@　Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000C71.en: 「Guh! Nothing to do but fall back!!」

0x000D4E.en: 「This is the end... the rest is up to you.」

0x000D80.en: 「Damn it...!@　So this is the end!」

0x000DFA.en: 「No good, too much damage... I'm retreating!」

0x000E47.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E85.en: 「Kyah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000ECC.en: 「To think the Granzon... could be shot down...」

0x000F77.en: 「Ngh... so I'm the one who becomes a shooting star... I'm ejecting!」

0x0010B3.en: 「Nn... gh! So this is the end...!」

0x001167.en: 「I'm sorry... I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x00119C.en: 「Damn it! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x001288.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still not ready...!」

0x0012D6.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x001391.en: 「Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x0013C0.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013FE.en: 「Well, well... so this is the end.」

0x00142D.en: 「I can't go on any further. If you'll excuse me.」

0x0014B8.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x00161E.en: 「Ejecting...@ ngh...! So much for looking cool...」

0x0016DC.en: 「Guhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x00184B.en: 「So I still have far to go...!」

0x0018AC.en: 「A-all hands!@ Abandoning ship is top priority...!!」

0x001989.en: 「Helmsman, stabilize the ship!@ Eita, have you found the cause of the gravity anomaly!?」

0x0019FB.en: 「It's not a control system malfunction,@ it looks like it triggered as an emergency measure!」

0x001A67.en: 「There's a gravity anomaly in the space around us...@ no, wait! It's space! Outer space!」

0x001AD5.en: 「Don't be absurd! We were on Earth just now!」

0x001B21.en: 「Putting the outside view on the main screen!」

0x001B96.en: 「Eita, confirm our current position!@ Azuki, hail the Hiryu Kai!」

0x001C5B.en: 「That's strange, the satellite link won't work.@ Azuki, how is it on your end?」

0x001CEE.en: 「Even MOSS is hard to reach...@ Guess we'll have to calculate from Earth and the moon's positions.」

0x001D5E.en: 「No, wait!? What is this!?@ Something's wrong!」

0x001DDC.en: 「C-Captain... the Earth... the Earth is gone!@ It's vanished!」

0x001EC3.en: 「To be precise, it's become invisible... I think.@ The moon's still in orbit, and there's no anomaly@ at the Lagrange points either.」

0x001F9F.en: 「This is still just conjecture, but...@ it seems the Ruina have covered the Earth@ with something like a barrier.」

0x002048.en: 「You could call it a dimensional rift.@ Because of it, all communication with Earth is impossible...@ and we can't come and go, either.」

0x0020E4.en: 「What's the basis for saying the Ruina did this?」

0x002121.en: 「The ES wave that heralded this crisis@ spread out from the direction of the South Pole.」

0x002192.en: 「And it passed between the Hagane and the Hiryu Kai,@ then expanded outward all at once. That's probably@ why we were thrown out into space.」

0x002252.en: 「Then what about the Earth...@ what's happening to it now?」

0x0022A8.en: 「Most likely the sun's light is being blocked by the rift...@ leaving it sealed in darkness.」

0x002319.en: 「If that state continues, it'll be catastrophic.」

0x002381.en: 「First it affects atmospheric circulation... then the ocean currents.」

0x0023D4.en: 「Right. Even though the oceans store heat,@ the temperature gap between land and sea will spawn violent storms along the coasts.」

0x00245A.en: 「Roughly put, the energy coming into Earth is@ visible light, and the energy going out is far infrared...」

0x0024E9.en: 「Because that inflow and outflow balance out, Earth's@ temperature is roughly maintained. But if that balance@ breaks down...」

0x00258B.en: 「Snowball Earth...@ in other words, a total global freeze is possible.」

0x002603.en: 「You mean an ice age is coming...?」

0x00263A.en: 「Not that it'll happen right away, but...@ the imminent, serious problem is the power grid.」

0x0026BA.en: 「With no sunlight and falling temperatures,@ the whole world will switch on lighting and heating, all at once...」

0x002737.en: 「When that happens, the surge in demand@ could overload and blow out the power grid.」

0x00279C.en: 「There's also the psychological damage to consider.@ If the crisis drags on, people's hearts will waver...@ and turn to despair.」

0x00283B.en: 「Then that's exactly what the Ruina want.」

0x002875.en: 「Yes... the world will be filled with the negative@ energy waves they feed on.」

0x0028DA.en: 「What is to become of us now...?@ I took the life of President Graien...@ and now we have nowhere left to go home to...」

0x0029CC.en: 「The fleet approaching us is the@ Space Force's 3rd Orbital Patrol Squadron.」

0x002A68.en: 「And if we defy them, they won't hesitate to attack...@ We do bear an unforgivable sin, after all.」

0x002B19.en: 「...I'll make contact with them. All hands, battle stations, Condition One.」

0x002B7B.en: 「Just in case.@ If it comes to it, we make an emergency break. Be ready for it.」

0x002BED.en: 「This is the Earth Federation Space Force,@ 3rd Orbital Patrol Squadron commander, Colonel Humphrey Inez.@ Respond, Hagane.」

0x002C89.en: 「Far East Command, 1st Independent Special Task Force,@ Hagane captain, Lieutenant Commander Tetsuya Onodera speaking.」

0x002D06.en: 「...Colonel Humphrey Inez, is it.@ This is going to be a headache.」

0x002D7E.en: 「A rarity in the Space Force, a captain who rose from Earth.@ A survivor of the S08 Field, one of the fiercest@ battlegrounds of Operation SRW.」

0x002E51.en: 「Yeah. And stubborn as a rock, too.」

0x002E82.en: 「Colonel Humphrey, does the Space Force have any@ information on the Earth's disappearance...」

0x002EE1.en: 「You don't need to know.@ As of 1200 hours today, all Steel Dragon Squadron personnel@ have been stripped of military status.」

0x002F7E.en: 「Therefore, your operation of that vessel is deemed@ private appropriation, an act of treason against the@ Federation government and military.」

0x00301D.en: 「Disarm and surrender at once.@ Note that you are also under suspicion@ of assassinating the President.」

0x0030A1.en: 「Should you fail to comply with our directives,@ understand that we are granted the right@ to a preemptive strike.」

0x003122.en: 「Please wait, Colonel!@ The matter of the President is a false charge.@ We had no hand in it.」

0x0031A0.en: 「No, this isn't the time for that debate.@ With the Earth gone, we need to find the cause@ and a response - that's what matters...」

0x00323F.en: 「That is no concern of those without military status.」

0x00327D.en: 「Answer at once: do you accept disarmament or not?」

0x0032BA.en: (He values carrying out his orders over the crisis@ right in front of him. No... as a soldier,@ that's how it should be, but...)

0x003365.en: 「I told you to answer at once, Lieutenant Commander.」

0x0033AC.en: 「Very good. I'll dispatch a boarding party.@ From here on, you'll follow their instructions, Lieutenant Commander.」

0x003440.en: 「We can't fight friendly forces in a situation like this.」

0x0034B1.en: 「Our machines are all non-standard.@ Even sealing them within the ship@ would take a considerable amount of time.」

0x003545.en: 「All hands, hold at battle stations. Maintain full-perimeter alert,@ so we can respond instantly if anything happens.」

0x0035EA.en: 「Yeah... I've got a bad feeling.@ And we're sitting still. To the enemy,@ we're a perfect target.」

0x00366E.en: 「Understood.@ I'll tell the deck chief to handle them courteously.@ To buy us time, as well.」

0x0036EC.en: 「...No sign of resistance, hm.@ Obedient, for a pupil of that Daitetsu Minase.」

0x0037B7.en: 「During Operation SRW, I witnessed the Steel Dragon@ Squadron's valor with my own eyes.」

0x00382B.en: 「If we'd ended up fighting them,@ I doubt we'd come out unscathed.@ Especially in a situation this abnormal...」

0x0038BB.en: 「So you'll help spread that propaganda too.@ The victory in the L5 Campaign was not won@ by their strength alone.」

0x003957.en: 「A warped operational doctrine of concentrating our best@ weapons in specific units is all that produced@ those standouts. Nothing more.」

0x0039EA.en: 「Had we balanced the operation and positioned forces properly,@ the Great Arc wouldn't have sunk...@ Admiral Norman Slay wouldn't have died.」

0x003ABC.en: 「Both the Steel Dragon Squadron and Gaia Sabers are just@ extreme cases of ISA tactics - the latter, outside@ military jurisdiction...」

0x003B79.en: 「Multiple high-heat sources approaching! Three o'clock, elevation 05,@ coming straight in! Range 3... no, they've entered Range 2!」

0x003C36.en: 「Believed to be high-speed missiles!@ On a direct-hit course for this ship!」

0x003CD7.en: 「Hit to the upper stern, starboard frame 476!@　Starboard main engine, output dropping!」

0x003D33.en: 「Repulse is hit!@　Enemy contacts identified! It's the Ruina!」

0x003D89.en: 「What!?@　Earth's gone, so where the hell did they come from!?」

0x003DD9.en: 「Could the Ruina have existed@　out in space too...!?」

0x003E2F.en: 「I've had no such report...!@　Azuki, open a line to the Repulse!」

0x003EA7.en: 「Commander Inez, the enemy is the Ruina!@　We'll intercept, so pull your ship out!」

0x003F1E.en: 「I take no orders from you.@　You mean to use the chaos to slip away.」

0x003F71.en: 「We have combat experience against the Ruina!@　At least grant us permission to intercept!」

0x003FD9.en: 「Denied.@　Your ship's forces are all under my command.@　You will not act on your own authority.」

0x004060.en: 「Second missile wave, closing on our ship! Direct-hit course!」

0x0040A6.en: 「! Are they reading our evasive maneuvers!?」

0x004121.en: 「Captain, the enemy has locked onto the Repulse!」

0x004164.en: 「Launch our PT squad!@　Draw the enemy's attention!」

0x0041DC.en: 「That the Federation will brand us@　traitors too. Is that it?」

0x00424B.en: 「Then... I'll dare to wear that label!」

0x00428F.en: 「Traitors or not,@　we can still chase the truth of Earth's vanishing,@　and fight the Ruina and the Guests.」

0x004316.en: 「Then there's no reason to hesitate...@　And we cannot let it all end here.@　Launch every machine at once!」

0x0043A6.en: 「You've steeled yourself, Captain.@　That decisiveness... you're starting to resemble Captain Daitetsu.」

0x004411.en: 「Better than firing on our own side.@　Though it'll cause friction down the road.」

0x004467.en: 「Only if we both survive.@　...Ariel, Ing. The situation's what it is.@　I'll be counting on your strength.」

0x004511.en: 「Ing, this is your first space battle.@　Until you adjust, stay off the front line and cover the Hagane.」

0x004594.en: 「No need to worry. I've already adjusted.」

0x0045D1.en: （Already adjusted...? Such high adaptability.@　And to stay this calm even now...）

0x0046A1.en: （This sensation... my body remembers it.@　My first time doing it for real... but I can.）

0x004709.en: 「Elve 1 to all units.@　Combat in Earth-visible space -- but you see the situation.」

0x004774.en: 「Set aside the fact that Earth has vanished for now.@　Stay calm and deal with the threat.」

0x0047DF.en: 「We'll be fine, Major.@　After all these battles, we've seen more than@　our share of impossible things.」

0x004866.en: 「It's so unreal it almost@　doesn't feel like it's happening.」

0x0048C2.en: 「I see.@　Then don't forget to change your second MO.@　Leave it set to Earth and you'll lose track of your own position.」

0x004955.en: 「Arado, you heard him.@　Change your MP setting properly.」

0x0049C4.en: 「Princess Shine too...@　I'll send the optimal fixed-star MO setting besides the sun.@　It's already adjusted for this battle zone.」

0x004A76.en: 「Princess, Earth, Riksent...@　You must have many worries, but stay strong.@　We're right here with you.」

0x004B27.en: 「Thank you, Latooni.@　I won't falter until I'm home again.」

0x004BEB.en: 「Enemy group, six o'clock, elevation 25! Entering range 2!」

0x004C74.en: 「Commander, pull out of the battle zone now!@　We'll cover you!」

0x004CC7.en: 「I told you I take no orders from you!」

0x004D01.en: 「We can't just leave our allies to die!」

0x004D41.en: 「If we don't get through this,@　there'll be no forces left for you to seize, will there?」

0x004DCE.en: 「Pull out at once.@　We'll handle things here.」

0x004E21.en: 「So be it... I order you to intercept the Ruina.@ But I will not tolerate you acting without my orders.」

0x004E98.en: 「'No acting without orders,' he says...@ Does he expect us to check in over every little thing?」

0x004F06.en: 「A battlefield calls for flexibility.@　We'll judge things as they come. Eita, set the defense line.@　Keep a close watch on the 3rd Fleet's movements too.」

0x004FBD.en: 「And plot a few escape routes@　out of the battle zone.@　Just exclude the twelve-to-three o'clock direction.」

0x00504A.en: 「...Ah, so we don't flee toward the hardheaded one?」

0x00508A.en: 「Exactly.@　We're putting on a show, so coordinate@　with Steven and get everything ready.」

0x0050FC.en: 「All units, don't let the enemy reach the 3rd Fleet.@　Hold them here.」

0x00515E.en: 「I've handed the defense-line setup over to you.」

0x005198.en: 「Confirmed.@　Steel 2 to all units. Stop the enemy from@　breaking through the defense line.」

0x00520D.en: 「Elve 1 to all units.@　You heard it -- don't let them past the line!」

0x0052C2.en: 「Unknown approaching! Two o'clock, elevation 30, straight in!　　　　@　Entering range 2! Just one!」

0x005370.en: 「So they're the ones forming the wall.@　Seems the outside world has some lively ones too. Heh heh heh.」

0x005412.en: 「A machine I've never seen...@　Could it be a Melior Esse?」

0x00546E.en: 「No noise runs through me on contact with them...@　So that human and machine we fought on the way here@　were the exceptions?」

0x005520.en: 「The unknown's cutting into the open channel!」

0x005567.en: 「I am Ignis... the Melior Esse of flame.@　Carve my name into your memory, with terror and hatred!」

0x005631.en: 「He's got more visual impact than the last one.」

0x00567A.en: 「Looks just like some villain from a tokusatsu show.」

0x0056AB.en: 「Your world has been sealed in darkness.@　This land of endless night, this sky, and this void --@　I'll light them all with the flames of ruin!」

0x00579D.en: 「First... it was the Ruina who created@　the dimensional rift. Second, Earth@　hasn't completely vanished.」

0x005854.en: 「And third, the Ruina's dimensional rift@　has an entrance and exit.」

0x0058B6.en: 「Right, if that Ignis guy came here...」

0x00590C.en: 「Then the reverse works too -- there's a way for us to get back to Earth!」

0x00595B.en: 「If we can, I'd like to capture him@　to get that information.」

0x0059DC.en: 「In a crisis like this, no time for buts and maybes.」

0x005A3E.en: 「Captain Viletta's right.@　We need intel on Earth's disappearance.」

0x005A9A.en: 「All units, keep capturing Ignis's machine in mind@　and begin the attack. But if we start@　taking losses, abandon the capture.」

0x005B45.en: 「Come, humans!@　Your negative emotions, those waves,@　shall feed the 'King of Ruin'!」

0x005BC0.en: 「If you're the ones who erased Earth,@　then you know how to put it back, don't you!?」

0x005C31.en: 「Even so,@　there's no need to tell the likes of you.@　Despair here, and die!」

0x005CA0.en: 「Heh, I ain't despairing.@　You showing up here proved@　we can cross between here and Earth!」

0x005D3F.en: 「Just who is this 'King of Ruin'?@　Was sealing Earth away its will?」

0x005DB3.en: 「That doubt breeds still greater terror!@　I'll not tell you yet... no, you need not know!」

0x005E2A.en: 「Erasing Earth itself...@　quite an elaborate magic trick you've shown us.」

0x005E8F.en: 「Heh heh heh, it won't end there.@　You'll witness an even greater tragedy!」

0x005F0C.en: 「Hmph, every trick has its secret.@　Before your show begins,@　I'll expose it for you.」

0x005F96.en: 「Judging by your forces and actions now,@　I doubt you're here with any do-or-die resolve...@　Reinforcements must still be coming.」

0x006050.en: 「And the reverse holds.@　Which means the dimensional rift is no absolute barrier...」

0x0060B5.en: 「Hmph, you're never going back!@　Because you die here!」

0x00610B.en: 「Now, curse your own weakness too!@　Raise your voice in terror!」

0x00615B.en: （There is no fear.@　Combat in space... my first, yet my body knows it.）

0x0061BA.en: （And to learn why that is...@　I cannot let it end here.）

0x00622B.en: 「Fear me, hate me!@　Your wavering emotions become waves, become source power!」

0x00629F.en: 「That's got nothing to do with me.@　I emit no emotional waves.」

0x006335.en: 「Aren't the Melior Esse much the same?」

0x00637E.en: 「Hmph, I've no use for a doll like you.@　Break apart and be done with it!」

0x0063D4.en: 「Hmph, these ones put up a fair fight too.@　But struggle as you may...」

0x0064A7.en: 「Have you forgotten our true mission?@　We've only just come across, and our forces are too few.@　Come back.」

0x006534.en: 「How timid. Can't you manage on your own?」

0x00656E.en: 「Don't you see that building a foothold early@　serves us better later? Or are you@　a failure? Heh heh heh.」

0x00660E.en: 「If you say otherwise, then prove it.」

0x0066A5.en: 「...You got lucky, humans. We'll meet again.」

0x006707.en: 「Enemy retreating out of the zone at high speed!」

0x00676F.en: 「It's weaving, but from the@　orbital data we can estimate its destination.」

0x0067C8.en: 「Good, pull out of the zone and regroup.@　Depending on the situation, we pursue the Ruina.」

0x00683C.en: 「Understood.@　Shall we handle the withdrawal@　as we proposed?」

0x0068C1.en: 「...Azuki, order all units back aboard.@　Don't let them approach the upper main mast or the@　stern starboard frames around 400 to 500.」

0x00699A.en: 「After that, put on a good act for me.」

0x0069CE.en: 「I'm not confident, but... I'll manage somehow.」

0x006A11.en: 「Counting on you.@　...Relay to gunnery, navigation, and engineering. Begin the operation.」

0x006A67.en: 「Hagane to Repulse!@　Engine section damaged! Steering disabled!@　Repeat, steering disabled!」

0x006AD9.en: 「Repulse to Hagane!@　Report your situation in detail!」

0x006B57.en: 「...That's our cue.@　Half speed ahead. Weave and pull out of the zone!」

0x006C21.en: 「Sir. It seems the earlier clash with the Ruina@　damaged their engine section.」

0x006C80.en: 「...Do they think a farce like that@　will fool my eyes?」

0x006D07.en: 「We've taken damage as well.@　In this abnormal situation, regrouping the squadron@　is the top priority.」

0x006D85.en: 「On our own, we might not@　have driven off the Ruina.」

0x006E40.en: 「Hmph... budget-be-damned super machines and test weapons.@　With all that gathered, of course they could.」

0x006EB1.en: 「For that to spiral out of anyone's control...@　I won't allow it. All the more so in an emergency.@　Report this incident to Space Force Command.」

0x006F83.en: （Still, on the question of what we should be fighting...@　even they didn't get that part wrong.）

0x0070F8.en: 「Formerly known as Skull Head...@　Where we were held captive during <the Shura Rebellion>.」

0x007196.en: 「Officially, <Isurugi Heavy Industries>@　is supposed to be refitting it, but...」

0x007200.en: 「In truth it's under the Gaia Sabers' control,@　slated for use as a space-based outpost.」

0x0072E8.en: 「If the Ruina are heading for Heaven's Gate,@　that means... do they need a base@　in space too, I wonder?」

0x00739F.en: 「Likely so.@　So, Captain... what do you intend to do?」

0x0073F2.en: 「Hunted by the Federation and the Gaia Sabers or not,@ learning to break through the dimensional rift@ is our urgent priority, I think.」

0x007494.en: 「If a Ruina we can communicate with --@　a Melior Esse -- has gone to Heaven's Gate,@　then we should go there too.」

0x007536.en: 「But the Guests are in space too.@　It could become a bitter fight, with no one to aid us.」

0x0075A4.en: 「Even so, we can't just keep running.@　Stripped of our commissions or not, if we still have the power to fight...」

0x007633.en: 「And in a situation like this...@　it should be turned against the external enemy.」

0x00768C.en: 「Heh... If the commander does not waver,@ the troops can fight all out. Let's go, to Heaven's Gate,@ to find the key to taking Earth back.」

0x00774D.en: 「No, really...@　Earth's an even bigger den of horrors than I imagined.」

0x0077A0.en: 「We can analyze the phenomenon,@　but I can't even guess what kind of device@　could pull off something like that.」

0x007833.en: 「Before any of that, if Earth's gone,@　doesn't that make our coming here pointless?」

0x0078A5.en: 「No... this actually works in our favor.」

0x0078E9.en: 「We seize the Moon while we can.@　As things stand, the apes can't mount a real defense.@　Do it at once.」

0x007983.en: 「So what do we do about the Unknowns that@ crawled out of the South Pole? They might show up in space too, y'know.」

0x0079F1.en: 「We drive them off as well, of course.@　For that we'll need Heaven's Gate as a base.@　Send forces there too.」

0x007AA0.en: (Earth's disappearance was unforeseen...@ but that Unknown tech could be a real prize if we get our hands on it...)
